mapper.sql: cp.*, u.nickname AS owner_name, COALESCE(l.lead_count, 0) AS lead_count, COALESCE(l.converted_count, 0) AS converted_count, COALESCE(o.opp_count, 0) AS opp_count, COALESCE(o.won_amount, 0) AS won_amount, COALESCE(so.order_amount, 0) AS order_amount, COALESCE(ar.received_amount, 0) AS received_amount

FROM crm_campaign cp LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = cp.owner_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS lead_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CONVERTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS converted_count FROM crm_lead WHERE campaign_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY campaign_id) l ON l.campaign_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS opp_count, SUM(CASE WHEN stage = 'WON' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS won_amount FROM crm_opportunity WHERE campaign_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY campaign_id) o ON o.campaign_id = cp.id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT op.campaign_id, SUM(so.total_amount) AS order_amount FROM crm_opportunity op JOIN scm_order so ON so.id = op.sales_order_id AND so.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVING') WHERE op.campaign_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY op.campaign_id) so ON so.campaign_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT op.campaign_id, SUM(b.settled_amount) AS received_amount FROM crm_opportunity op JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.order_id = op.sales_order_id JOIN fin_bill b ON b.source_id = d.id AND b.source_type = d.kind WHERE op.campaign_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY op.campaign_id) ar ON ar.campaign_id = cp.id
